title: the global 5 ms exemption admits a genuine missing-checkpoint loop
trigger: I extracted the exact window measurement and assertion into a scratch integration test, then registered an **async builtin** with a loop of small CPU operations. The loop can yield; a switch enables a checkpoint every 32 iterations.
measured:
ASYNC-ASSERTION target_ms=4 checkpoints=false longest_us=4000 window_us=4000 old_pass=false new_pass=true
ASYNC-ASSERTION target_ms=4 checkpoints=true  longest_us=24   window_us=4000 old_pass=true  new_pass=true
ASYNC-ASSERTION target_ms=6 checkpoints=false longest_us=6000 window_us=6000 old_pass=false new_pass=false
HOLD gap: longest=4.000452ms window=4.000452ms succeeded=true
how_found_quote: The actual `assert_yields_throughout` returned successfully for the checkpoint-free 4 ms loop. Thus the exemption does admit the requested counterexample

title: under 5% was not independently reproduced
trigger: I used the lane's benchmark source, the exact baseline, separate fresh target directories, and the optimized `local` profile. All samples asserted shell exit zero. Arm order rotated/interleaved. No outcomes were excluded.
measured:
| Initial three-arm run | 10 rounds × 3 samples; overlapped reviewer compilation | 2.7485 s | 2.8350 s | +3.15% |
| Two-arm run, no concurrent reviewer builds | 10 rounds × 3 samples | 2.6840 s | 2.8195 s | +5.05% |
| Two-arm run matching the lane's five-sample protocol, no concurrent reviewer builds | 10 rounds × 5 samples | 2.644259 s | 2.796502 s | **+5.76%** |

These are medians of invocation medians, the lane's primary measure. Pooling all 50 samples in the last run gives **+5.57%**, not a contrary under-5% result. A descriptive paired-round bootstrap 95% interval for the last primary estimate is **+4.19% to +6.83%**. That interval is not evidence of a precise universal regression above 5%, but neither the point estimate nor the uncertainty supports signing off a reliably under-5% result. Other VM tenants were not controlled. The five-sample run was added to match the lane's protocol after the three-sample run was near the threshold; all runs are retained and reported.
